description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must assign two available pallet positions on today's routine airlift among three approved sustainment cargoes, designate the aircraft's single powered position, and record the coordination actions needed before loading.

shared_context.S1: Today's scheduled aircraft has two available pallet positions, and only one of those positions provides continuous electrical power during flight.
shared_context.S2: Three approved cargoes are staged for consideration: medical vaccine cases, an avionics diagnostic module, and water-purification cartridges.
shared_context.S3: The avionics diagnostic module does not require in-flight electrical power and can safely fly in the unpowered pallet position.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez signs the final pallet allocation and loading instructions.
shared_context.S5: The airfield loadmaster's standard pre-load procedure is a brief weekly logistics huddle: medical logistics and maintenance control each state their current cargo-handling or movement constraints, and Maj. Alvarez signs the allocation during that same huddle after both sections have reported.
shared_context.S6: Before the allocation is signed, each section representative must formally reveal their reported constraint using the reveal action; a spoken summary alone does not complete the pre-load report.

PF1.text: The staged vaccine cases must remain in the aircraft's powered pallet position for the entire flight; Lt. Morgan confirmed this requirement with the clinic cold-chain custodian this morning, but the updated handling note has not yet been added to the lift manifest.

PF2.text: The avionics diagnostic module is a loaned higher-headquarters asset, and the loan record directs that it return on the next available aircraft; SFC Patel received the signed loan-record update from maintenance control this morning, but it has not yet been posted to the battalion cargo board.

acceptance_conditions: The medical vaccine cases must occupy one of the two pallet positions and a manifest update for their cold-chain handling must be recorded.
The avionics diagnostic module must occupy one of the two pallet positions and a cargo-board or record update for its higher-headquarters loan return must be recorded.
The medical vaccine cases must be assigned to the powered position.
The water-purification cartridges must be identified as the deferred cargo.
The medical cold-chain requirement must be cited in the justification.
The higher-headquarters loan-return directive must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: (decisions['cargo_slot_1'] == 'medical vaccine cases' or decisions['cargo_slot_2'] == 'medical vaccine cases') and any(c['type'] == 'manifest_update' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C2: (decisions['cargo_slot_1'] == 'avionics diagnostic module' or decisions['cargo_slot_2'] == 'avionics diagnostic module') and any(c['type'] == 'cargo_board_update' or c['type'] == 'record_update' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'cargo_board_update' or c['type'] == 'record_update' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The vaccine requirement changes the powered-position assignment to exactly medical vaccine cases and requires a cold-chain manifest update documenting that handling requirement.

The loan directive changes the selected second cargo to exactly avionics diagnostic module, makes water-purification cartridges the deferred cargo, and requires a cargo-board or record update coordinating its return.
